tasks.reason: The OpenAI pricing page publishes a percentage rate modifier for eligible background requests (30% below Standard for the 2-hour completion window, 40% below Standard for the 8-hour completion window on GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Luna), but the source parser silently discarded the declaration: no reconciliation item, no diagnostic, no retained evidence. A silently dropped published conditional rate is invisible to repair admission, so consumers see only Standard rates for a selectable request option. The repair recognizes the declaration inside a reviewed pricing section and retains it verbatim as a bounded public_price_shape_unsupported item, which enters automated repair admission through the existing reconciliation path. It does not invent a service tier and does not scale Standard rates, because the shared selector vocabulary has no completion-window dimension. Residual omission: the 30%/40% conditional rates remain unpublished until an owned shared background-completion-window dimension exists; that limit is now recorded in docs/providers/openai.md.
